On perusal of the record, we find that the earlier application for suspension of sentence of the applicant being D.B. Criminal Misc. Suspension of Sentence Application (Appeal) No.161/2022 was dismissed as not pressed by the co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 10.03.2022.
4.

entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: Thereafter, the present second application for suspension of sentence has been preferred by the applicant's father.

5. We are of the considered opinion that once the application for suspension of sentence has been rejected on merit or as withdrawn, no fresh application for suspension of sentence is maintainable,
but for exceptional circumstances including the event when an accused has completed a sentence of 10 years (as has been observed by Hon'ble the Supreme Court in the case of Saudan Singh vs. The State of Uttar Pradesh : SLP (Crl.) No.4633/2021).
6.

entities.text: Saudan Singh vs. The State of Uttar Pradesh : SLP (Crl.) No.4633/2021
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Considering the date of incident i.e. 30/31.05.2016, we are sure that 10 years' sentence of the applicant has not been over.
The application for suspension of sentence, is therefore, rejected, while giving a liberty to the applicant to move a fresh application once the requisite period of sentence is complete.

(REKHA BORANA),J   2-raksha/-
